content.short: Modulr automates business payments, providing accounts, cards and payment rails through an API.
content.description: Modulr is the payment engine inside a lot of British and European software, handling payroll runs, supplier payments, spend management and collections for businesses that would rather not build against bank files themselves. Accounts and cards are issued programmatically, and payments settle through direct access to the underlying schemes rather than through another bank. More than 6,000 businesses use it, moving over 180 billion pounds. It holds electronic money institution permissions from the UK regulator and from De Nederlandsche Bank.
